origin.summary: Workout 4 of the 2011 CrossFit Open. The Open is the worldwide online qualifying stage of the CrossFit Games season: one workout released each week, completed and scored by hundreds of thousands of athletes in affiliates and garages on the same few days.

description: A 10-minute AMRAP of 60 bar-facing burpees, 30 overhead squats, and 10 muscle-ups — one long round rather than a fast-repeating circuit.
source_notes: games.crossfit.com/workouts/open/2011/4 (official CrossFit Games Open workout), retrieved 2026-07-09
